display_information.name: Neucleus
display_information.description: Specialist AI ecosystem for generic oral softgel development.
display_information.long_description: Neucleus converts a request in Slack into a controlled programme of work across a network of specialist pharmaceutical AI agents. It plans the work, runs the relevant specialists, challenges contradictions between them, and returns an Executive Decision Brief plus a DOCX report. Every run, evidence item, assumption, conflict and human decision is persisted for traceability. Neucleus is advisory: it never executes a regulatory submission, batch release or any other binding action without explicit human approval.
